answer_provenance.method: single green option label (RGB 0,128,0); four option labels required

solution: Solution: Use the relation between $K_p$ and $K_c$ . For $A(g) \rightleftharpoons B(g)+C(g)$ , $\Delta n = (\text{moles of gaseous products})-(\text{moles of gaseous reactants})=2-1=1$ . The relation is $K_p = K_c(RT)^{\Delta n}$ . Given $K_c = 10\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}$ , $R = 0.082\ \mathrm{atm\ L\ mol^{-1}\ K^{-1}}$ , and $T = 1000\ \mathrm{K}$ . So $RT = 0.082 \times 1000 = 82\ \mathrm{atm\ L\ mol^{-1}}$ . Thus $K_p = 10\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}} \times 82\ \mathrm{atm\ L\ mol^{-1}} = 820\ \mathrm{atm}$ . Therefore, the correct option is $820$ . © examsnet.com
